blocks.text: If a sanitary sewer account becomes delinquent, water service may be discontinued and shut off pursuant to K.S.A. 12-860 , as may be amended. (Ord. 19496 § 100, 12-21-10; Ord. 19370 § 100, 3-23-10. Code 1995 § 146-351. Formerly 14.80.870.)
